title: Private tour of the Montmorency Falls of 2h e-SUV 7 places
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the spectacular Montmorency Falls, one of the most striking natural attractions near Quebec City. During this stopover, you will experience the falls from the top and bottom, offering two completely different and unforgettable perspectives of this impressive waterfall.

At the top, visitors will enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the St. Lawrence River and the surrounding landscape. At the base, they will approach the powerful waterfall, feel the refreshing mist and capture incredible photos of one of Quebec's iconic sites.

This stopover is the perfect opportunity to take memorable shots, admire the raw beauty of the falls and experience one of the most impressive natural wonders in the area.
